# What will hosted search cost for your records and monthly searches, and who is cheapest?

> Enter your record count and monthly searches and see what Algolia, Meilisearch Cloud, Typesense Cloud, Elastic Cloud and a self-hosted box cost, the 12-month spend under your growth rate, and the query volume where the cheapest option changes. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
